scope: Public reports for reproduction triage, not benchmark ground truth

cases.title: EOS generation disappears after fine-tuning
cases.symptom: Llama-2 chat models repeat assistant text and stop emitting EOS after SFT.
cases.caveat: The author reports success with a different padding token. This is not a controlled project reproduction; the linked TinyLlama report has a different explanation.
cases.reproduction_plan: Pin the original trainer stack; inspect EOS labels after collation. Compare identical data with padding separated from EOS, then compare EOS emission under matched training budgets.
missing: Complete original dataset and pinned environment

cases.title: Incomplete accumulation cycle scales the loss incorrectly
cases.candidate_cause: Loss divided by configured accumulation count rather than actual final count
cases.symptom: The final incomplete accumulation cycle has an artificial loss drop.
cases.caveat: The maintainer distinguishes models using num_items_in_batch. This report does not establish a downstream fine-tuning quality drop for our models.
cases.reproduction_plan: Use the supplied synthetic example on transformers 4.51.3. Compare gradients and parameter updates with an equivalent full batch, including remainder batches; assess quality separately.
missing: Successful full prespecified mechanism reproduction; accumulation-3 controls failed
Original BERT/GPU case reproduction and downstream quality measurement

cases.title: Mistral emits conversation delimiters after successful training
cases.candidate_cause: Chat formatting or stopping configuration; unconfirmed
cases.symptom: Successful fine-tuning is followed by unexpected instruction delimiters and continued conversation.
cases.caveat: The author still reports the symptom after applying the suggested chat-template preprocessing. The thread does not confirm a fix.
cases.reproduction_plan: Use synthetic non-medical text. Inspect training and inference tokenization, EOS configuration and decoded continuation separately before any training comparison.
missing: Original training data, confirmed cause and controlled fix

cases.title: GSM8K fine-tuning differs between training pipelines
cases.candidate_cause: Training or evaluation pipeline difference; unconfirmed
cases.symptom: The reporter measures lower GSM8K performance than a comparison training pipeline.
cases.caveat: The reporter checked matching tokenized outputs and also tried one GPU. These observations do not identify a unique cause.
cases.reproduction_plan: Freeze evaluation extraction and decoding first. Compare package versions, labels, padding and optimizer updates with the same dataset and model.
missing: Validated common evaluation protocol and causal isolation

cases.title: Stagnant loss after changing TRL versions
cases.candidate_cause: Unknown; version and packing explanations disputed
cases.symptom: A reporter observes stagnant training loss after upgrading TRL.
cases.caveat: Later comments challenge dtype and packing explanations; the original environment is no longer available. A renamed-argument exception is a separate hard failure.
cases.reproduction_plan: Retain as an abstention case. Do not assign a fault label without a reproducible original configuration and a matched intervention.
missing: Original environment, reproducible stagnation and confirmed cause
